title: Club and stationary set library for Mathlib (refactor of Fodor pressing-down infrastructure)

problemStatement.formal: \text{Refactor }\mathsf{IsClubBelow},\,\mathsf{IsStationaryBelow},\,\mathsf{diagInter},\,\mathsf{IsRegressive}\text{ out of }\texttt{FodorPressingDown.lean}\text{ into }\texttt{Proofs/Club/Basic.lean}\text{ under the }\mathsf{Ordinal}\text{ namespace}
problemStatement.plain: Lift the club / stationary-set / regressive-function infrastructure currently embedded in proofs/Proofs/FodorPressingDown.lean into a standalone Mathlib-style library file (proofs/Proofs/Club/Basic.lean) under the Ordinal namespace, so that sister slugs (Solovay splitting, Galvin's theorem, Erdős–Tarski rigidity) can depend on a single shared module instead of redefining the same predicates. No new mathematical content; design decisions (naming, universe-polymorphism boundary, structure-vs-Prop) are locked in S1 OBSERVE.
whyMatters: Library debt reduction: 5 definitions + 3 mechanical lemmas currently inaccessible to sibling files.
Sister-slug enablement: fodor-pressing-down-oq-04 (Solovay splitting) is the primary downstream consumer, currently in NEW phase.
Mathlib upstreaming path: the new module is the obvious Mathlib.SetTheory.Ordinal.Club candidate.

open: OQ-01-A: structure-based vs Prop-only IsClubBelow (S1 lock: structure, matching local file).
OQ-01-B: universe polymorphism for Cardinal.{u} (S1 lock: definitions polymorphic; combinatorial lemmas pinned at Cardinal.{0}).
OQ-01-C: file placement Proofs/Club/Basic.lean vs flat OrdinalClub.lean (S1 lock: Proofs/Club/Basic.lean).

insights: Mathlib's Ordinal.IsAcc + IsClosedBelow already cover the closed half of clubs; only IsUnboundedBelow + the club bundling structure are genuinely new.
The combinatorial core (diagInter_isUnboundedBelow) is the only piece that requires regularity (κ.IsRegular + ω < κ.ord); it can stay in the parent file while everything else moves.
The sister slug fodor-pressing-down-oq-04 (Solovay splitting, NEW phase since 2026-05-12 14:35 UTC) will save ~50 LOC of redefinition by importing the lifted module on its first commit.

Set.Unbounded (general-order, in Mathlib) and the proposed Ordinal.IsUnboundedBelow are not interchangeable: the latter requires the upper bound o : Ordinal as a parameter, the former takes a relation.
mathlibGaps: No Ordinal.IsClub / IsStationary / diagInter / IsRegressive predicates (as of v4.26.0).
Set.Unbounded does not specialise cleanly to ordinal-indexed bounded intervals.
